'''Loposi Three''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Loposi system/Legends|Loposi system]]<ref name="The Healing Moon" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Loposi Three's moon]] possessed an artificial [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of nutrient-rich gases that were derived from liquid [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]], a medicinal plant.<ref name="The Healing Moon" /> The Loposi system was later a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
